# Message fixtures

Sample decoded Fourvale messages for adapter tests. Generated by `tools/scripts/make_message_fixtures.py` from captures made on **2026-10-01** (Fourvale client `0.98` Beta, bundle `main-DZfOvN-x.js`). Each file has a `_fixture` header (date, build, source) and the `payload`.

Sanitising: redacted at capture time (tokens, e-mails, chat), then player and guild names become `PlayerNN` / `GuildNN`, session, room and process ids become `<ID_n>`, and battle tickets become `<TICKET>`. Enemy names, map ids and skill effects are game content and are kept. `FixtureHygieneTests` enforces this.

| File | Message |
|---|---|
| `matchmake-town.json`, `matchmake-battle.json` | Matchmake responses (room name, ids, own `sessionId`) |
| `hpSync.json` | HP/SP sent on room join |
| `startBattle.json` | Battle start with enemies and rewards |
| `damage-hit.json`, `damage-heal.json` | Damage and heal events |
| `battleOver.json` | Battle result |
| `teleport.json` | Zone change |
| `consumables.json` | Consumable counts |
| `log-joined.json` | Battle log line naming a player and class |
